$comment: Canonical, language-neutral configuration for the Slotify heuristic baselines. Loaded by thin loaders in TypeScript (backend/src/lib/heuristic-config.ts), the backend Python pipeline (backend/ad_inserter/heuristic_config.py), and the ML package (ml/src/slotify_rank/config/settings.py). This file is the single source of truth: do not duplicate these numbers in code. Changing any value changes the baseline and REQUIRES bumping config_version and regenerating ml/tests/fixtures/heuristic_golden.json.

heuristic_offline_v1.description: The canonical, deterministic, offline product-path baseline. Reproduces the ranking behaviour of backend/src/lib/candidates.ts plus the deterministic slot finalisation in backend/src/routes/insert-sections.ts:136-260. Requires no network access, no API credentials, and no model downloads.

legacy_cli_v1.description: NOT the canonical baseline. Records the divergent constants of the standalone CLI insertion path (backend/ad_inserter/cli.py), where the final insertion point is chosen by an LLM rather than by a score. Preserved verbatim for behaviour compatibility and documented so its behaviour is never silently merged into heuristic_offline_v1.
